ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Arabic word means "I"? (1 mark)
   A. مَا اسْمُكَ؟
   B. أَنَا
   C. مَرْحَبًا
   D. شُكْرًا

2. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My name is Ahmad.
   B. I am a pupil (girl).
   C. I am a pupil (boy).
   D. I am from Kenya.

3. What does the Arabic word السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) mean? (1 mark)
   A. I
   B. How are you? (to a boy)
   C. good morning (the reply)
   D. peace be upon you

4. What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My sister reads.
   B. This is my father.
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. This is my mother.

5. What does the Arabic word أُخْتٌ (ukht) mean? (1 mark)
   A. family
   B. father
   C. grandmother
   D. sister

6. What does the Arabic word طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) mean? (1 mark)
   A. pen
   B. cat
   C. chair
   D. table

7. Which Arabic sentence means "The lamp is above the table." (1 mark)
   A. الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   B. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ
   C. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   D. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ

8. How is the Arabic word اُخْرُجْ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. uktub
   B. iftahi l-baab
   C. aghliqi l-baab
   D. ukhruj

9. What does the Arabic word الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. Friday
   C. Wednesday
   D. week

10. Which phrase would you say to a friend on a birthday? (1 mark)
   A. ʿafwan
   B. ʿiid miilaad saʿiid
   C. maʿa s-salaama
   D. kayfa haaluka?

11. What does the Arabic word حَلْوَى (halwaa) mean? (1 mark)
   A. festival
   B. sweets
   C. my turn
   D. no

12. Which Arabic sentence means "Do you have a party? (to a boy)" (1 mark)
   A. عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ
   B. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ
   C. كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ
   D. هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟

13. Which sentence means 'Do you like bananas?' (1 mark)
   A. uhibbu l-mawz
   B. aakulu l-mawz
   C. hal tuhibbu l-mawz?
   D. ashrabu l-mawz

14. What does the Arabic word لَحْمٌ (lahm) mean? (1 mark)
   A. eggs
   B. meat
   C. bread
   D. carrots

15. What does the Arabic word رَأْسٌ (raʾs) mean? (1 mark)
   A. body
   B. shoulder
   C. mouth
   D. head

16. Which Arabic sentence means "This is my hand." (1 mark)
   A. أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   B. أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي
   C. هَذِهِ يَدِي
   D. أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي

17. What is intonation? (1 mark)
   A. The size of letters
   B. The speed of writing
   C. The number of words
   D. The rise and fall of the voice when speaking

18. How is the Arabic word زَهْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. zahra
   B. haarr
   C. sahaab
   D. nadhiif

19. Which Arabic sentence means "Thank you for listening." (1 mark)
   A. آكُلُ الْأَرُزَّ
   B. فِي بَيْتِي مَطْبَخٌ
   C. شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ
   D. أَنَا فِي الصَّفِّ الرَّابِعِ

20. Which is good body language for a speaker? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding behind the paper
   B. Turning your back
   C. Looking at the floor
   D. Standing straight and looking at the audience

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give two reasons why we should take care of household items. (2 marks) (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: al-qittatu taHta s-sariir (2 marks)

23. Write five members of the family in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

24. Give three ways of taking care of your body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Describe two things you can do to pronounce the days of the week correctly. (2 marks) (2 marks)

26. Translate into English: al-jawwu haarr (2 marks)

27. Translate into English: fii l-usbuuʿi sabʿatu ayyaam (2 marks)

28. Write in Arabic sounds and translate: 'The weather is cold.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

29. Write the Arabic greeting for 'peace be upon you' in English letters and give the reply. (2 marks) (2 marks)

30. Translate into English: uhibbu l-ʿasiira (2 marks)

31. State the job of each part of a speech: opening, middle and closing. (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Write a short conversation of three lines in which one friend asks about a party and the other answers. Use English letters. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #4 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — أَنَا
   أَنَا (anaa) means I.

2. C — I am a pupil (boy).
   أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

3. D — peace be upon you
   السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ (as-salaamu ʿalaykum) means peace be upon you.

4. A — My sister reads.
   أُخْتِي تَقْرَأُ (ukhtii taqraʾu) means: My sister reads.

5. D — sister
   أُخْتٌ (ukht) means sister.

6. D — table
   طَاوِلَةٌ (taawila) means table.

7. C — الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ (al-misbaahu fawqa t-taawila) means: The lamp is above the table.

8. D — ukhruj
   اُخْرُجْ is read ukhruj and means go out.

9. C — Wednesday
   الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') means Wednesday.

10. B — ʿiid miilaad saʿiid
   ʿiid miilaad saʿiid means 'Happy birthday'.

11. B — sweets
   حَلْوَى (halwaa) means sweets.

12. D — هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟
   هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ (hal ʿindaka hafla?) means: Do you have a party? (to a boy)

13. C — hal tuhibbu l-mawz?
   hal makes a question and tuhibbu means 'you like'.

14. B — meat
   لَحْمٌ (lahm) means meat.

15. D — head
   رَأْسٌ (raʾs) means head.

16. C — هَذِهِ يَدِي
   هَذِهِ يَدِي (haadhihi yadii) means: This is my hand.

17. D — The rise and fall of the voice when speaking
   Intonation is how the voice goes up and down.

18. A — zahra
   زَهْرَةٌ is read zahra and means flower.

19. C — شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ
   شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

20. D — Standing straight and looking at the audience
   Eye contact and a steady stance help the audience to listen.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: They last longer and save money, and keeping them in the right place keeps us safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cat is under the bed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ab (father), umm (mother), akh (brother), ukht (sister), jadd (grandfather).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands and face; clean teeth; eat good food; sleep well; play outdoors.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the teacher and repeat; say the days in a chain; practise the sounds th and kh slowly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid method.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is hot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: There are seven days in a week.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: al-jawwu baarid. The weather is cold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Arabic sounds and 1 mark for the translation.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: as-salaamu ʿalaykum. The reply is wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the greeting and 1 mark for the correct reply.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like juice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Opening: greet and say who you are. Middle: give the information. Closing: thank the audience.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: A: hal ʿindaka hafla? B: naʿam, ʿindii hafla. A: mabruuk!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question, 1 mark for the answer and 1 mark for a suitable closing wish.
